authorized_tables.purpose: Cardinality-neutral authorization relation; no assumption that one account owns exactly one learner and no public linking behavior.

authorized_tables.purpose: Immutable manifest identity and checksum metadata only; no activation or invented scientific configuration.

authorized_tables.name: b_sessions

authorized_tables.name: b_session_events
authorized_tables.purpose: Append-only technical and lifecycle audit events with privacy-safe payloads; no learner answers or scientific outcomes.

authorized_tables.name: b_idempotency_records

authorized_tables.name: b_audit_events

be2_scope.endpoint_note: No new BE2 API, CRUD, lifecycle, recovery, resume, or summary endpoint is authorized. Existing BE1 endpoints are unchanged.
be2_scope.transition_note: The vocabulary may be constrained in the schema, but no transition may be executed against live data in this limited scope.
required_constraints: Supabase subject is unique in app_users and is never used as learner_id.
learner_id and session_id are opaque UUIDs.
Account-to-learner mapping must not encode a one-to-one assumption.
grade is nullable and, when present, restricted to integer 2 or 3 with no default.
At most one session in starting or active state per learner.
Published runtime-bundle records are immutable; no bundle may be marked active without complete approved checksums.
Session active state requires an immutable approved runtime-bundle reference; because none exists, live activation fails closed.
Session and audit event records are append-only.
Mutable projections use a non-negative row version.
All timestamps are timezone-aware UTC and are server generated.
No cascading deletion may silently erase audit or scientific history.
Synthetic and test rows exist only in isolated non-live databases and cannot be promoted or copied into real learner records.

required_idempotency_behavior.scope: authenticated actor plus HTTP method plus route/operation plus idempotency key
required_idempotency_behavior.same_key_same_body: return the canonical committed response without repeating the mutation
required_idempotency_behavior.concurrent_replay: serialize through a unique constraint and lock; never execute twice
required_idempotency_behavior.atomicity: idempotency record and domain mutation commit in the same transaction
required_idempotency_behavior.client_event_id: future state-changing mobile commands also require a command-scoped unique client event ID

prohibited_scientific_fields: sequencing feature values scores weights or selection rationale
task private snapshot answer key distractor rules or generated task
attempt limit timeout threshold completion threshold or safe-progress mapping
submitted or normalized answers correctness error class or mastery delta
explicitly_prohibited_scope: outbox or Component C/Component 3 integration table
session start resume recover abandon expire complete APIs
real learner or child data collection
full research-generator wheel or Yass source in the application

be2_exit_criteria: Only authorized tables and constraints are implemented through reviewed Alembic migrations.
Schema and repository tests use visibly synthetic identities in an isolated test database.
Migration upgrade downgrade upgrade passes in Docker PostgreSQL 16.
No new public endpoint or session lifecycle execution exists.
No item opportunity attempt mastery hint sequencing summary progress or integration table exists.
No scientific or synthetic-only field module wheel source path or dependency exists in the application.
Idempotency and concurrency constraints are proven at the repository/database layer.
Provenance and privacy-safe audit fields are present and sensitive values are absent from logs.
A BE2 closure review confirms the limited boundary and records which governance approvals are still required before BE3 or any live behavior.
